criteria: AC-1: Dual-suite sdd_vulnerability_catalog_baseline + sdd_vulnerability_catalog_target is registered in root Cargo.toml.
AC-2: On e2def07, baseline is GREEN and target is RED for missing control.vulnerability.* / fixtures, not unrelated compile errors.
AC-3: After implement, target is GREEN; baseline is ignored/retired; workspace demo tests stay green on files this slice touches.
AC-4: Twenty control.vulnerability.* controls exist (count 15–25) with stable ids, domains, evidence, tests, and honest automation class.
AC-5: §4.4 evidence types are declared as structured facts (severity, age, status, subject, discovery/remediation time, exception) without a scanner product id.
AC-6: Tests include the seven Prompt-06 ids and evaluate populations, not existence of one envelope.
AC-7: Finding status enum open|resolved|accepted-risk|false-positive|exception-approved|unknown is used; accepted-risk and approved exception are not remediation.
AC-8: Empty findings plus unknown coverage cannot yield Effective (zero-findings-unknown-coverage).
AC-9: critical-inside-sla passes no-critical-over-sla; critical-overdue fails it naming the subject.
AC-10: critical-approved-exception is not resolved; critical-expired-exception reopens SLA as Ineffective.
AC-11: incomplete-scan-coverage (8 of 10) cannot prove all 10 clean; stale-scan is StaleEvidence.
AC-12: unresolved-secret-exposure fails test.secret.no-active-exposure; dependency-confusion has declared evidence and test.
AC-13: duplicate-superseded counts one open subject; resolved-not-accepted-risk rejects FP/accepted-risk collapsed into resolved.
AC-14: Validator/suite rejects duplicate/orphan ids and provider/scanner/framework tokens in vuln catalog IDs and TOML narrative.
AC-15: ISO pack vulnerability.remediation and mappings are unchanged; sdd_iso27001_assurance_target stays green; IAM files are not rewritten as the vuln library.
AC-16: No second CanonicalCatalog loader, EvidenceValue, or local population-math fork.
AC-17: Scanner engines, Codex schemas, and bridge.rs are not redesigned; no provider collector; no ISO remap; no certification language.
AC-18: Prompt 01–04 SSOT documents are not overwritten by this slice.
